name: vibe-shuffle
description: Personal-reference-informed research system for reviewable next-song selection.

scripts.test: npm run test:catalog && npm run test:data && npm run test:expression && npm run test:physiology && npm run test:selection
scripts.paper:figures: python3 paper/figures/fig1_affect_space.py && python3 paper/figures/fig2_relative_trajectory.py && python3 paper/figures/fig3_pilot_evidence.py
scripts.paper: npm run paper:figures && cd paper && latexmk -pdf -shell-escape -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -output-directory=build main.tex && cp build/main.pdf ../public/paper.pdf
